feedback.end: Penguins usually lay 1-2 eggs and look after them for around 13 months!
Baby penguins are called chicks and they will eventually hatch from the egg. Hatching means the chick comes out of the egg.
After another couple of months, the chick grows into an adult penguin. The cycle begins again when the penguin lays an egg.

feedback.correct: Correct. This picture shows an emperor penguin. These birds are found in Antarctica and cannot fly.

b.sound: a penguin looking after its egg

feedback.correct: Emperor penguins carry their eggs on their feet, so the eggs don’t get cold from the snowy ground.

b.sound: penguin chicks and an adult penguin

feedback.correct: Penguins have feathers all over their body to keep them warm. These feathers also help with speedy swimming!
